programs.description: The host presents dramatised re-enactments of the country's most shocking and real-life criminal cases and their investigation.
Chunri is a young girl who is a woman's helper. Later, when the woman gets married, she accompanies her and is part of her dowry.
The host engages in conversation with various celebrities about their personal life, and they also compete in several fun challenges.
Agni, a doctor, crosses paths with Vāyu, an investment banker, and the two start to like each other. Together, they try to decipher the mysterious deaths of those who were close to them.
An educated woman's career ambitions are thwarted when she's obliged to marry into a male-dominated household. However, she embarks on a mission to emancipate the women around her.
Anmol, a young woman of short stature, aspires to be a doctor but faces struggles due to societal bias and stereotypes. Despite all the odds, she is determined to achieve her dream.
